description: This file contains the implementation of a PHP class 'Smarty_Internal_Compile_Private_Object_Block_Function' that extends a base class and provides a method 'setup' to prepare callback and parameter arrays for Smarty template compilation, specifically for object block functions registered with Smarty templates.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Compile_Private_Object_Block_Function
classes.description: A class responsible for compiling object block functions within the Smarty templating engine, handling setup of callback functions and parameters for template rendering.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Prepares callback and parameter array for a Smarty object block function, mapping attributes and method to a callback structure.
